text: Cartoon capsule bursting open on the ground: one crisp bright rounded pop at the very start, immediately followed by a soft airy puff of smoke billowing out and hissing away for about one second. Playful toy-like gadget sound, dry, no reverb, no music, no voice.
Cartoon reverse suction: a quick rising whoosh being sucked inward into a tiny capsule, ending with a small soft pop. Playful toy-like gadget sound, dry, no reverb, no music, no voice.

Small mechanical push button on a plastic capsule: press down click then the spring snaps it back up, a quick click-clack, two soft crisp clicks about 0.2 seconds apart, close-up, dry, no reverb, not shrill.
